notes: Events 001-047 unchanged: works complete; the agency emailed the landlord the invoice on Monday 2 June 2025 (event 045: £1,190, attachment-04-invoice.pdf, the tap did not need replacing; the email names 'Flat 13, 83 Harbour View' in error), skipped photos ('No photos attached', event 046) and recorded 'Need confirmation from landlord' (event 047).
